children.name: Velutina plicatilis
children.description: Velutina plicatilis is a species of small sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Velutinidae.

children.name: Velutina velutina
children.description: Velutina velutina, common name the velvet shell, is a species of small sea snail with a transparent shell, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Velutinidae.

children.name: Onchidiopsis glacialis
children.description: Onchidiopsis glacialis is a species of small sea snail with a transparent internal shell, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Velutinidae.

children.name: Marsenina rhombica
children.description: Marsenina rhombica is a North Pacific species of velutinid, a group of marine molluscs that have fragile internal shells and are slug-like in appearance.

children.name: Marsenina stearnsii
children.description: Marsenina stearnsii is a species of small slug-like sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Velutinidae.

children.name: Marsenina uchidai
children.description: Marsenina uchidai is a species of velutinid, a type of gastropod, and appears outwardly similar to a dorid nudibranch. However, it has an internal shell hidden by the mantle. It inhabits Asian boreal waters off of Japan and Russia.
